properties.description: This workflow sorts the words in a string and returns them in a text file.
properties.name: word_sorter_pipeline
properties.cwl:
cwlVersion: v1.2
$namespaces:
  s: https://schema.org/
  edam: http://edamontology.org/
$graph:
- class: Workflow
  id: word_sorter_pipeline
  inputs:
    text:
      type: string
      doc: String to split into words and sort alphabetically.
  steps:
    step_word_sorter:
      run: '#word_sorter'
      in:
        text: text
      out:
      - sorted_words_file
  outputs:
  - id: sorted_words
    outputSource: step_word_sorter/sorted_words_file
    type: File
    format: edam:format_2330
    doc: Text file containing the words in alphabetical order.
  requirements:
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}
  s:name: word_sorter_pipeline
  s:description: 'This workflow sorts the words in a string and returns them in a
    text file.

    '
  s:keywords:
  - word sorting
  - text processing
  s:programmingLanguage: Python
  s:softwareVersion: 0.1.0
  s:producer:
    class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:sourceOrganization:
  - class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:author:
  - class: s:Person
    s:name: "Jo\xE3o Campos"
    s:email: joao.campos@inesctec.pt
  s:codeRepository: https://github.com/pastilhas/example-workflow/tree/main/
  s:dateCreated: '2026-11-06'
  s:identifier: urn:apkg:workflow:inesctec:pt:word_sorter_pipeline:0.1.0
  s:sdDatePublished: '2026-11-06T12:01:26.285614Z'
  s:sdPublisher:
    class: Organization
    name: Application Package Registry
    url: https://iliad-registry.inesctec.pt
- class: CommandLineTool
  id: word_sorter
  inputs:
    text:
      type: string
      doc: String to split into words and sort alphabetically.
    output_file:
      type: string
      default: sorted_words.txt
      doc: Name of the text file to write the sorted words to.
  outputs:
    sorted_words_file:
      label: Sorted words text file
      doc: Words from the input string sorted alphabetically, separated by spaces.
      type: File
      format: edam:format_2330
      outputBinding:
        glob: $(inputs.output_file)
  requirements:
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: iliad-repository.inesctec.pt/word-sorter:0.1.0
  s:name: word_sorter
  s:description: Sorts the words in a string without regard to case and writes them
    to a text file.
  s:keywords:
  - word sorting
  - text processing
  - Python
  s:programmingLanguage: Python
  s:softwareVersion: 0.1.0
  s:producer:
    class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:sourceOrganization:
  - class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:author:
  - class: s:Person
    s:name: "Jo\xE3o Campos"
    s:email: joao.campos@inesctec.pt
  s:codeRepository: https://github.com/pastilhas/example-workflow/tree/main
  s:dateCreated: '2026-10-30T18:00:00Z'
